package.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.

en-US.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
KyteShelf is an elegant, multi-workspace desktop shelf for Windows.
It acts as a temporary holding zone and staging area for frequently accessed files, quick drag-and-drop actions, sticky notes, and tags.
en-US.name: KyteShelf
en-US.releaseNotes:
1. [拖曳修復] 修正從檔案總管拖曳本機檔案時，因 FileGroupDescriptorW 重疊而誤抓 Ctrl+C 剪貼簿檔案的問題
2. [虛擬檔案隔離] 拖放事件改由 QMimeData 獨立提取虛擬檔案，徹底與系統剪貼簿解耦
3. [穩定性強化] 拖放本機檔案後即時持久化儲存工作階段
4. [Drag & Drop Fix] Fixed an issue where dragging local files from File Explorer could mistakenly grab Ctrl+C clipboard files
5. [Virtual File Isolation] Decoupled drag-and-drop virtual file extraction from the system clipboard
6. [Reliability] Immediately persist session state after dropping local files",
